name: Wishbone Kitchen
overview: Pull up a kitchen stool and press play. Each week, Meredith Hayden — the voice behind Wishbone Kitchen — sits down to talk cozy, crave-worthy recipes, real kitchen tips, and the small rituals that turn a house into a home. It's the kind of podcast that makes you want to light a candle, pour a glass of wine, and press record on your own kitchen story.
